rules.message: This grid sets no licenseKey. In 18.1 a missing or invalid license key covers the grid with a modal that cannot be closed. Pass a valid key to every instance, in every environment, including local development, CI, and test suites. The codemod never adds a key. For where to get one, see https://handsontable.com/docs/javascript-data-grid/license-key/#get-a-license-key

In 18.1 a column header sorts on mouse up, and only the header label (.colHeader.sortAction) and its sort indicator respond. A test that dispatches only mousedown on a header cell no longer sorts. Dispatch mousedown and then mouseup on the label without moving the pointer, or click the label itself.

In 18.1 beforeColumnMove and afterColumnMove run only when the pointer drags a column. They no longer run on a plain header click. If you use this hook to detect a header click, move that logic to afterColumnSort or afterOnCellMouseUp.

In 18.1 the loading plugin renders title and description as text, so this markup now shows up literally. Drop the markup and style .ht-loading__title and .ht-loading__description with CSS. The icon option is the one slot that still takes markup.
The 18.1 themes no longer ship Pikaday styles, and Handsontable has not used Pikaday since 18.0. This .pika-* rule has nothing to style. Remove it.
